title: VirnetX (VHC) Wins $502.6 Million in Federal Case vs Apple (AAPL)
text: VirnetX (VHC) Wins $502.6 Million in Federal Case vs Apple (AAPL) April 11, 2018 6:21 AM VirnetX Holding (NYSE: VHC ) won $502.6 million against Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) after a federal jury in Texas said Apple was infringing patents for secure communications, according to a report from Bloomberg. The jury said Apple infringed four communications patents. Shares of VirnetX were set to open higher by 42% Wednesday morning. Categories Corporate News Hot Corp.
